description: Return the search demand behind a project: the branded and non-branded split of its organic search traffic, the top organic queries with their shares and month-over-month change, and, with include_paid, the top paid queries. Individual queries identify a site in any search tool, so before a reveal only the split is returned. After a reveal, each query's month-over-month change is an exact number even with precision: band. Costs the base price plus the keywords price for every project whose keywords your organization does not already hold, and with precision: exact a surcharge for every revealed project on every call; a project without search data comes back with profile null and is charged neither the part nor the exact surcharge. Ask in bands first, and for exact values only when your user needs exact numbers.

estimate.description: When true, run the query but return only its composition, price and a quote_token instead of data

include_paid.description: Include top paid queries (revealed projects only)

precision.description: band (default) or exact; exact applies only to revealed projects, adds a surcharge for each of them, and is otherwise ignored with a note

quote_token.description: Execute a previous estimate: pass the quote_token instead of the query parameters

refs.description: Projects to describe; refused above batch.get_keywords in capabilities; required unless quote_token is given

items.description: Opaque project id as returned by this server to your organization

name: get_keywords
title: Search keywords
